title: Hyperloom campaign spec v1
description: What a hosted Hyperloom run is asked to do. Unknown fields are ignored. The platform that hosts the run never reads it; resources are requested separately. 'multibranch' is opaque here: it is handed untouched to the multibranch entry.

flow.description: Optional; multibranch by default. conc_sweep sweeps the closed multi-branch session conc_sweep.session_dir names and optimizes nothing. The retired 'single' is refused.

multibranch.description: Opaque; not validated by this schema. A spec must name flow or carry this section: one with neither was written for the retired single flow and is refused.

source_changes.description: false holds the multi-branch session to server arguments and environment variables (run --no-source-changes): its toolbox refuses every test whose recipe holds a patch or a kernel artifact. Not taken with multibranch.autonomous_agents.

eval.description: The accuracy eval cannot be turned off; false is refused.

measurement.description: local (measured on the application container's own cards) is accepted only with profile hosted-gpu.

conc_sweep.description: Read for flow conc_sweep only, and refused beside any other flow.

session_dir.description: The closed multi-branch session to sweep: an absolute path below the run's USER_DATA_PATH, with no link or .. on the way, that the run can read and write; the report is written back into it. Its TP, GPU type and framework must be the spec's.

concs.description: The concurrencies to sweep, in place of those the session's InferenceX recipe publishes; the session's own is always among them.

parallel.description: The sweep's tests running at once; within placement.max_parallel_tests.
